info.name: Task Manager API
info.description:
Every route of the Task Manager API, **one request per route**.

**Setup:** `docker compose up -d` (Postgres + Mailpit), `npm run start:dev`, then select the **Task Manager API · Local** environment.

**Run order:** the folders are numbered. Run the whole collection with the Collection Runner, or send the requests top to bottom. Tokens and ids are saved to collection variables automatically.

**Two users:** user A (`{{accessToken}}`) is created in 01 · Auth. User B (`{{accessToken2}}`) is created by the pre-request script of Create invitation.

**Auth:** the collection uses Bearer `{{accessToken}}`. Public routes are set to No Auth; user B's requests override it with `{{accessToken2}}`.

**Responses:** success bodies are wrapped in `{ data: ... }`; errors are `{ error: { code, message, requestId } }`.

exec: // Runs after every request: the rules every endpoint follows
pm.test('Error has code, message and requestId', () => {

item.name: 00 · Health
item.description: Checks that the API and the database are up. No token needed.

request.description: Returns `{ status: 'ok', database: 'up' }`, or 503 `DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE`.

item.name: 01 · Auth
item.description:
Account lifecycle for **user A** (the task owner in later folders).

Run in order: Register → Resend verification → Verify email → Forgot password → Reset password → Login → Me.

Verify email and Reset password read their token from Mailpit automatically (pre-request script), so Mailpit must be running (`docker compose up -d`).

request.description:
Creates an account and returns `{ user, accessToken }`. Sends a verification email.

The pre-request script generates a fresh email and username every run, so this never fails with 'already taken'. Rate limit: 5 per minute.

// Login uses currentPassword, because Reset password changes it later

request.description:
Sends a new verification email to the logged-in, **unverified** user. Returns 202.

One email per minute: right after Register this returns **429** (cooldown). After verifying it returns **409** (already verified). Both are expected.

Marks the email as verified using the token from the email link. Returns 204.

The pre-request script reads the newest verification token for `{{email}}` from Mailpit. After this, user A can use every protected route.

item.name: 02 · Tasks
item.description:
Task CRUD as user A. Requires a verified email (run 01 · Auth first).

Create task saves `{{taskId}}`; the other requests use it. Delete task removes it.

request.description: Creates a task owned by the logged-in user. Only `title` is required. `deadlineAt` must be in the future; `status` defaults to `todo`.

exec: // A deadline 7 days from now, because past deadlines are rejected

request.description: Tasks the user owns and/or collaborates on, paginated. Enable the optional query parameters in the Params tab to filter, search and sort.
One task, if the user is its owner or a collaborator. Otherwise 404.
Owner only. Send only the fields to change. `deadlineAt: null` removes the deadline. Collaborators get a `task.updated` notification.
Owner or collaborator. `todo` | `in_progress` | `done`. Moving to `done` sets `completedAt`. Everyone else on the task gets a `task.status_changed` notification.
Owner only. Deletes the task permanently. Collaborators get a `task.deleted` notification.

item.name: 03 · Invitations
item.description:
Sharing a task. **User A** (owner, `{{accessToken}}`) invites **user B** (collaborator, `{{accessToken2}}`).

Create invitation's pre-request script creates the shared task (`{{collabTaskId}}`) and registers + verifies user B through Mailpit. Run this folder in order.

request.description: Owner only. Invite by `username` **or** `email` (exactly one). An email without an account is allowed; it is linked when that person signs up and verifies. User B gets an `invitation.received` notification.

exec: // Finds the newest email with this subject sent to `to` in Mailpit (the local mail catcher),
// and passes the 64-character token from the link inside it to `done`.
throw new Error(`No "${subject}" email for ${to} in Mailpit. Is Mailpit running?`);
// Mailpit lists the newest message first
if (!match) throw new Error('No token found in the email');
// Sends a JSON POST to the API. token is optional (null for public routes).
// This request needs two things no earlier request creates:
//   2. a second verified user to invite (user B) → {{username2}}, {{accessToken2}}, {{userId2}}
// Both are created here, so the collection keeps exactly one request per route.

if (res.code !== 201) throw new Error('Could not create the shared task: ' + res.text());

request.description: Owner only. Pending invitations of the task, newest first.
**As user B.** My pending, unexpired invitations, with task title and inviter name.
**As user B.** Declines the invitation. User A gets an `invitation.declined` notification.

**As user B.** Accepts the invitation and becomes a collaborator. User A gets an `invitation.accepted` notification.

The pre-request script sends a fresh invitation first, because Decline used up the first one.

exec: // Sends a JSON POST to the API. token is optional (null for public routes).
// Decline invitation used up the first invitation, so user A invites user B again here.
// Allowed: user B declined, so there is no pending invitation and they are not a collaborator.
if (res.code !== 201) throw new Error('Could not re-invite user B: ' + res.text());

request.description: Owner only. Cancels a pending invitation. The pre-request script creates one to an email without an account, since user B's invitation is already accepted.

exec: // Sends a JSON POST to the API. token is optional (null for public routes).
// Revoking needs a PENDING invitation. User B already accepted, so invite an email that has
// no account yet (allowed: it becomes a pending invitation waiting for sign-up).
if (res.code !== 201) throw new Error('Could not create an invitation to revoke: ' + res.text());

item.name: 04 · Collaborators
item.description: Who is collaborating on the shared task. Uses `{{collabTaskId}}` and user B from 03 · Invitations.

request.description: Owner or collaborator. Everyone collaborating on the task, oldest first.
The owner can remove anyone; a collaborator can only remove themselves (leave). Here user A removes user B, who gets a `collaborator.removed` notification.

item.name: 05 · Notifications
item.description:
User A's notification inbox. After 03 · Invitations, user A has at least `invitation.declined` and `invitation.accepted` notifications.

**Real-time (Socket.IO):** not part of this collection (Postman collections can't hold Socket.IO requests). In Postman: New → Socket.IO, URL `http://localhost:3000/realtime`, Settings → Handshake auth `{"token": "<accessToken>"}`, listen for `notification.created`.

request.description: My notifications, newest first, with `total` for pagination. Saves the newest id.
Returns `{ count }`: how many of my notifications are unread (for a badge).
Marks one of my notifications as read and returns it. Another user's id returns 404.
Marks all my unread notifications as read. Returns 204.
